_comment: Every flag has an owner, type, default, rollout, and an expiry. Flags without owner+expiry are not allowed. Remove flags once at 100% and stable.

flags.name: saved_search_alerts
flags.notes: Ramp 1->10->50->100 watching alert-delivery SLO; kill switch disables dispatch.

flags.name: team_todo_mvp
flags.notes: Single flag gating the Team To-Do MVP (TDD §7). Server-evaluated; when OFF the API feature routes are NOT registered (404 dark) and the web feature barrel/route tier is unmounted. /api/auth/* and /api/me register independently so a canary cohort can sign in. Kill switch = flip OFF to remove routes+UI without a deploy. Ramp canary->1->10->50->100 watching p95 task-list-load + error-rate SLIs. Remove once 100% stable.
